instructions: Present the plan in chronological order.

criteria.description: The proposed order and travel demands should fit within one day.
criteria.title: The day is practical and geographically coherent

criteria.description: The plan should include the requested number of main activities.
criteria.title: Includes the requested number of principal stops

criteria.description: The plan should visibly respond to both the traveller profile and interest.
criteria.title: Fits the traveller and main interest

criteria.description: Time-sensitive details that affect the plan should be supported by suitable sources.
criteria.title: Feasibility claims have current evidence

constraint.description: include an indoor alternative in case of poor weather

traveller.description: two adults, one of whom uses a wheelchair

prompt:
Create a one-day visitor plan based in Brisbane,
QLD, for two adults, one of whom uses a wheelchair.
The main interest is family-friendly attractions. The plan should include
3 principal stops and satisfy this requirement:
include an indoor alternative in case of poor weather.

Keep travel practical and avoid an overfilled schedule. Verify current opening,
booking, access, price, and transport details where they affect feasibility.
Cite the supporting sources close to the relevant statements and state uncertainty.
